description:
Somos ASTROTICOS, un equipo de niños y jóvenes de la asociación ACADTYC unidos por nuestra curiosidad, creatividad y entusiasmo por descubrir cómo funciona el mundo y todo lo que existe más allá de nuestro planeta.

Nos interesan la ciencia, el espacio, la tecnología, la investigación, la innovación y la resolución de problemas.
summary:
**Forgotten Cosmic Explorers** is a digital educational project that aims to share the stories of the technologies that have contributed to space exploration. We developed a web platform that presents scientific and historical information about explorers such as Perseverance, Intrepid, Surveyor 1, and Voyager 1, accompanied by a multilingual interactive game in Spanish, English, and French.

The project addresses this challenge through an experience that combines research, science communication, and interactive learning. Its purpose is to introduce students to space missions, explain the function of their technologies, and show how they have contributed to our understanding of the solar system and interstellar space.

It is important because it allows us to recognize that space exploration depends not only on astronauts and discoveries, but also on the machines, instruments, and engineering that make it possible to reach further afield.
details:
Forgotten Cosmic Explorers is an educational project that seeks to rescue and share the stories of the technologies that have made space exploration possible. It consists of an informational platform and a multilingual interactive video game featuring four explorers: Perseverance, Intrepid, Surveyor 1, and Voyager 1.

The platform provides scientific and historical information about these technologies, their missions, characteristics, and contributions to space exploration. The video game, on the other hand, transforms learning into an adventure: the player accompanies an alien on a journey through the universe, discovers the space explorers, and answers trivia questions related to their histories and missions.

The project offers a different way to approach science, combining research, educational information, entertainment, and interaction. It also features content in Spanish, English, and French, expanding access and learning opportunities.

Its intended impact is to spark scientific curiosity, foster interest in space exploration, and help more people recognize the value of the technologies that have contributed to expanding our knowledge of the universe.

Its main creative element is changing the usual perspective on space exploration: instead of focusing exclusively on astronauts and planets, it foregrounds the machines, probes, rovers, and modules that made major missions possible.
